# MachineSignal

MachineSignal builds machine-readable APIs for CRM systems, RevOps workflows and AI agents.

Primary beta product: Lead Opportunity Score API.

Important URLs:
- https://machinesignal.it/
- https://machinesignal.it/api/
- https://machinesignal.it/beta/
- https://machinesignal.it/openapi.json
- https://machinesignal.it/beta-access.json
- https://machinesignal.it/postman_collection.json

The API is in private technical beta. Public endpoint access is not enabled yet. For beta access, contact beta@machinesignal.it.
